title: EdgeNOS platform (switch board) entry
description: One physical switch model. The bill-of-materials + build parameters that drive the version and package systems. Keyed by ONIE platform string.

onie_platform.description: ONIE machine string = the primary key, e.g. 'arm-accton-as4610-54-r0'. Verify with `onie-sysinfo -p`.

aliases.description: Other names/SKUs for the same board.

kernel.description: Kernel version this platform ships, e.g. '5.10'.

datapath.description: Datapath daemon package (overrides the asic default if set).

components.description: Package names composing this platform's image. Resolved to versioned .epk files at build time.

firmware.description: Firmware blob package(s) / files this board needs (PHY ucode, LED hex, etc.).

platform_dir.description: Relative path to the board support dir, default platform/<vendor>-<model>.

dts.description: Device-tree source name under the platform dir.

boot.description: Boot/install method: 'onie' (ONIE installer) or 'aboot' (Arista Aboot .swi — Linux-boots-Linux kexec, no ONIE).

installer.description: Installer envelope to emit ('aboot-swi' = Arista Aboot .swi zip).

status.description: Maturity of EdgeNOS support for this board.
